title: Established knowledge meets a living question

captions.emotions: Feeling a conclusion has fair proportions

meaning: Established knowledge can develop your shared view when a living case clarifies a principle’s meaning and a conclusion’s scale.
text: A familiar principle can reveal another meaning within a particular task. The Hierophant in the physical position of Ajna suggests consulting established knowledge and comparing experience with it. The Empress in energy supports a wish to grow useful understanding. Justice in emotions responds with proportion in the conclusion you find. Seeing learned knowledge help explain a living case can feel pleasing to both of you.

For example, you read a guide to planning an excursion route. “Move from simple to complex” initially looks like a requirement about the order of places. Discussing particular stops reveals that it may also concern how understandable the account is. **A living case helps reveal the measure of an established principle.** The sequence of places becomes distinguishable from the sequence of explanation. The meaning feels satisfying because it fits your task. The first version need not become bad; another subject may need another relationship between its parts.

The risk is treating successful development of a thought as permission to extend your explanation to every rule. Wanting fruitfulness, you may overlook the source’s limits. Creative interest stays meaningful when what you read remains distinguishable from your own application. Each conclusion can then retain an understandable scale. A shared view grows through the connection between knowledge and experience while leaving room for another particular case.
